mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO wechat_message (username, name, local_id, server_id, type, sender, content, quote, quote_kind, media_path, create_time, sort_seq, md5, msg_category, category_source, category_reason, status, relat_inq, relat_offer, entry_fail_count, classify_status, classify_fail_count, entry_status, entry_offer_count, task_status) VALUES
(#{m.username}, #{m.name}, #{m.localId}, #{m.serverId}, #{m.type}, #{m.sender}, #{m.content}, #{m.quote}, #{m.quoteKind}, #{m.mediaPath}, #{m.createTime}, #{m.sortSeq}, #{m.md5}, #{m.msgCategory}, #{m.categorySource}, #{m.categoryReason}, COALESCE(#{m.status}, 0), #{m.relatInq}, #{m.relatOffer}, COALESCE(#{m.entryFailCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{m.classifyStatus}, 'PENDING'), COALESCE(#{m.classifyFailCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{m.entryStatus}, 'NOT_APPLICABLE'), COALESCE(#{m.entryOfferCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{m.taskStatus}, 'PENDING'))
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE username = VALUES(username)

INSERT INTO wechat_message_black (username, name, local_id, server_id, type, sender, content, quote, quote_kind, media_path, create_time, sort_seq, md5) VALUES
(#{m.username}, #{m.name}, #{m.localId}, #{m.serverId}, #{m.type}, #{m.sender}, #{m.content}, #{m.quote}, #{m.quoteKind}, #{m.mediaPath}, #{m.createTime}, #{m.sortSeq}, #{m.md5})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE username = VALUES(username)
mapper.update: UPDATE wechat_message SET msg_category = #{m.msgCategory}, category_source = #{m.categorySource}, category_reason = #{m.categoryReason}, relat_inq = #{m.relatInq}, relat_offer = #{m.relatOffer}, classify_status = 'SUCCESS', classify_at = NOW(), classify_fail_count = 0, status = CASE WHEN #{m.msgCategory} IN ('INQ','OFFER') THEN 1 ELSE 3 END, entry_status = CASE WHEN #{m.msgCategory} IN ('INQ','OFFER') THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'NOT_APPLICABLE' END, entry_message = '', entry_at = NOW(), task_status = CASE WHEN #{m.msgCategory} IN ('INQ','OFFER') THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'SKIPPED' END, task_at = NOW(), task_message = CASE WHEN #{m.msgCategory} IN ('INQ','OFFER') THEN '' ELSE 'NOT_ROUTABLE' END WHERE username = #{m.username} AND local_id = #{m.localId} AND classify_status IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING','FAILED')

UPDATE wechat_message SET msg_category = 'OTHER', category_source = 'FILTER', category_reason = #{reason}, relat_inq = '', relat_offer = '', classify_status = 'SKIPPED', classify_at = NOW(), status = 3, entry_status = 'NOT_APPLICABLE', entry_message = #{reason}, task_status = 'SKIPPED', task_at = NOW(), task_message = 'FILTER' WHERE username = #{m.username} AND local_id = #{m.localId}

UPDATE wechat_message SET classify_status = 'PROCESSING', classify_at = NOW() WHERE username = #{username} AND local_id = #{localId} AND ( (classify_status IN ('PENDING','FAILED') AND (classify_at IS NULL OR classify_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{cooldownSec} SECOND))) OR (classify_status = 'PROCESSING' AND classify_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{timeoutSec} SECOND)) )

UPDATE wechat_message SET classify_status = 'FAILED', classify_fail_count = classify_fail_count + 1, classify_at = NOW(), category_reason = #{reason}, status = 0 WHERE username = #{username} AND local_id = #{localId} AND classify_status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE wechat_message SET msg_category = 'OTHER', category_source = 'NON_TEXT', category_reason = #{reason}, relat_inq = '', relat_offer = '', classify_status = 'SKIPPED', classify_at = NOW(), status = 3, entry_status = 'NOT_APPLICABLE', entry_message = #{reason}, task_status = 'SKIPPED', task_at = NOW(), task_message = 'NOT_ROUTABLE' WHERE username = #{username} AND local_id = #{localId} AND classify_status IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING','FAILED')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM wechat_message WHERE ( (classify_status IN ('PENDING','FAILED') AND (classify_at IS NULL OR classify_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{cooldownSec} SECOND))) OR (classify_status = 'PROCESSING' AND classify_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{timeoutSec} SECOND)) ) AND COALESCE(category_source,'') <> 'AI_AUTO' ORDER BY sort_seq ASC LIMIT #{max}
SELECT FROM wechat_message WHERE CONCAT(username, ':', local_id) IN #{key} ORDER BY sort_seq ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, MIN(create_time) AS earliest FROM wechat_message WHERE classify_status IN ('PENDING','FAILED')

SELECT FROM wechat_message WHERE classify_status = 'SUCCESS' AND msg_category = 'TRACE' AND category_source IN ('LLM','CACHE') AND trace_alerted_at IS NULL AND create_time >= #{since} AND ((relat_inq IS NOT NULL AND relat_inq != '') OR (relat_offer IS NOT NULL AND relat_offer != '')) ORDER BY sort_seq ASC LIMIT #{max}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, MIN(create_time) AS earliest FROM wechat_message WHERE classify_status = 'SUCCESS' AND category_source IN ('LLM','CACHE') AND msg_category IN #{cat} AND create_time >= #{since} AND entry_status IN ('PENDING','FAILED')

SELECT entry_status AS entryStatus, COUNT(*) AS cnt, MIN(create_time) AS earliest FROM wechat_message WHERE msg_category IN ('INQ','OFFER') AND create_time >= #{since} GROUP BY entry_status ORDER BY entry_status
mapper.update: UPDATE wechat_message SET entry_status = 'PROCESSING', entry_message = 'AI录入处理中', entry_at = NOW() WHERE username = #{username} AND local_id = #{localId} AND classify_status = 'SUCCESS' AND (entry_status IN ('PENDING','FAILED') OR (entry_status = 'PROCESSING' AND entry_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{timeoutSec} SECOND)))

UPDATE wechat_message SET status = #{messageStatus}, entry_status = #{entryStatus}, entry_message = #{entryMessage}, entry_offer_count = #{offerCount}, entry_offer_ids = #{offerIds}, entry_fail_count = #{failCount}, entry_at = NOW() WHERE username = #{username} AND local_id = #{localId}

UPDATE wechat_message SET entry_status = #{entryStatus}, entry_message = #{entryMessage}, entry_offer_count = #{offerCount}, entry_offer_ids = #{offerIds}, entry_fail_count = #{failCount}, entry_at = NOW() WHERE username = #{username} AND local_id = #{localId}

UPDATE wechat_message SET entry_status = 'PENDING', entry_message = '人工重新入队', entry_fail_count = 0, status = 1, entry_at = NOW(), task_status = 'PENDING', task_message = '', task_at = NOW() WHERE classify_status = 'SUCCESS' AND category_source IN ('LLM','CACHE') AND msg_category IN ('INQ','OFFER') AND entry_status IN ('SKIPPED','FAILED','DEAD') AND name = #{chat}

UPDATE wechat_message SET entry_status = 'PENDING', entry_message = '人工重新入队', entry_fail_count = 0, status = 1, entry_at = NOW(), task_status = 'PENDING', task_message = '', task_at = NOW() WHERE classify_status = 'SUCCESS' AND category_source IN ('LLM','CACHE') AND msg_category IN ('INQ','OFFER') AND entry_status IN ('SKIPPED','FAILED','DEAD') AND CONCAT(username, ':', local_id) IN #{key}
UPDATE wechat_message SET status = #{status}, entry_fail_count = #{failCount} WHERE username = #{username} AND local_id = #{localId}

UPDATE wechat_message SET task_status = 'PROCESSING', task_message = '任务生成处理中', task_at = NOW() WHERE username = #{username} AND local_id = #{localId} AND ( (entry_status IN ('SUCCESS','SUCCESS_WARN') AND task_status IN ('PENDING','FAILED')) OR (entry_status = 'SKIPPED' AND (entry_message LIKE '群未映射%' OR entry_message LIKE '群映射冲突%') AND task_status IN ('PENDING','FAILED')) OR (task_status = 'PROCESSING' AND task_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{timeoutSec} SECOND)) )
UPDATE wechat_message SET task_status = #{taskStatus}, task_message = #{taskMessage}, task_at = NOW() WHERE username = #{username} AND local_id = #{localId}
UPDATE wechat_message SET trace_alerted_at = NOW(), trace_alert_error = NULL WHERE username = #{username} AND local_id = #{localId} AND trace_alerted_at IS NULL
UPDATE wechat_message SET trace_alert_error = #{error} WHERE username = #{username} AND local_id = #{localId} AND trace_alerted_at IS NULL
